the Radon transform and its inverse can be dimensionally reduced to a form of texture-mapped frame buffer accumulation and that the resulting algorithm is highly amenable to hardware acceleration using texture mapping hardware.

the acceleration of volume rendering and tomographic reconstruction using texture mapping and graphics hardware.
